john1.4.p1.b1.text: Beloved, do not believe every spirit, but test the spirits to see whether they are from God. …

john1.4.p1.b2.text: For many false prophets have gone out into the world.

john1.4.p1.b3.text: Every spirit that confesses that Jesus Christ has come in the flesh is from God, …

john1.4.p1.b4.text: … every spirit that does not confess Jesus is not from God. This is the spirit of the antichrist, …

john1.4.p2.b1.text: You, little children, are from God and have overcome them, because greater is He who is in you than he who is in the world.

john1.4.p2.b2.text: They are of the world. That is why they speak from the world’s perspective, and the world listens to them.

john1.4.p2.b3.text: We are from God. Whoever knows God listens to us; whoever is not from God does not listen to us. …

john1.4.p3.b1.text: Beloved, let us love one another, because love comes from God. …

john1.4.p3.b2.text: Whoever does not love does not know God, because God is love.

john1.4.p3.b3.text: And love consists in this: not that we loved God, but that He loved us and sent His Son as the atoning sacrifice for our sins.

john1.4.p4.b1.text: Beloved, if God so loved us, we also ought to love one another.

john1.4.p4.b2.text: No one has ever seen God; but if we love one another, God remains in us, …

john1.4.p4.b3.text: By this we know that we remain in Him, and He in us: He has given us of His Spirit.

john1.4.p4.b4.text: And we have seen and testify that the Father has sent His Son to be the Savior of the world.

john1.4.p5.b1.text: If anyone confesses that Jesus is the Son of God, God abides in him, and he in God.

john1.4.p5.b2.text: … God is love; whoever abides in love abides in God, …

john1.4.p5.b3.text: There is no fear in love, but perfect love drives out fear, …

john1.4.p6.b1.text: We love because He first loved us.

john1.4.p6.b2.text: … anyone who does not love his brother, whom he has seen, cannot love God, whom he has not seen.

john1.4.p6.b3.text: And we have this commandment from Him: Whoever loves God must love his brother as well.
